summary.text: Lynn Chapman, an Independent American Party candidate and treasurer of the party's Nevada organization, according to the Nevada Independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Nevada's 2nd Congressional District to Teresa Benitez-Thompson, receiving 5.5% of the vote to Benitez-Thompson's 50.2%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
She also ran for the seat in 2024, finishing third with 19,784 votes, about 5 percent, in a race won by incumbent Mark Amodei.
